153:t_3:22.en:
$$リディ$$
「I don't give a damn about my family!」

153:t_3:24.en:
$$リディ$$
「A world like this has no meaning anymore! The world of a hundred years ago, when $$ラプラス$$ was bombed, is in pieces in this multiverse!」

153:t_3:25.en:
$$リディ$$
「And yet it's still the Box, the family, $$クロノ$$! We're bound by all that!」

153:t_3:26.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Do you... want to destroy the world?」

153:t_3:27.en:
$$リディ$$
「Even if it has no meaning, people still live in it...! There's nothing we can do! We have to keep protecting it!」

153:t_3:28.en:
$$リディ$$
「We can't turn everything upside down like those $$ジオン$$ people!」

153:t_3:29.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「That's right. The Box's secret must be protected...! $$ミネバ$$ knows that too!」

153:t_3:30.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「That's why I ask you to cooperate...」

153:t_3:31.en:
$$リディ$$
「Shut up! Your patriarch is the root of this whole mess!」

153:t_3:32.en:
$$リディ$$
「Your patriarch... $$サイアム・ビスト$$ only obtained the Box by chance!」

153:t_3:33.en:
$$リディ$$
「He rose to power by exploiting the assassination of $$ＵＣＷ$$'s... no, the $$宇宙世紀$$ $$連邦政府$$'s first president, and the hard-line policies it triggered. But...」

153:t_3:34.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$ジオン$$ demanded independence for the $$スペースノイド$$s, the $$一年戦争$$ broke out, and everything changed!」

153:t_3:35.en:
$$リディ$$
「Only then did the $$連邦政府$$, set on its course, and $$サイアム$$ himself, who set that course, finally realize!」

153:t_3:36.en:
$$リディ$$
「What their actions meant... The true power of $$ラプラスの箱$$...!」

153:t_3:37.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「You know that... You know what $$ラプラスの箱$$ truly is...」

153:t_3:38.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Please tell us what the Box is that torments you so much. Everyone here has a right to know.」

153:t_3:39.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Why does a relic of one world have meaning in this multiverse?」

153:t_3:40.en:
$$リディ$$
「...The multiverse... and parallel worlds... Those are just names. Every world is rotten in the same way...」

153:t_3:42.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$ミネバ$$, please come with me!」

153:t_3:44.en:
$$リディ$$
「The $$ユニコーン$$ is dangerous...! No, it's not just that machine that's dangerous!」

153:t_3:45.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$ニュータイプ$$s and $$イノベイター$$s are dangerous... No, $$コーディネイター$$s are too!」

153:t_3:46.en:
$$リディ$$
「Their existence will turn $$ラプラスの箱$$... the prayer offered in one world a hundred years ago... into a curse!」

153:t_3:48.en:
$$リディ$$
「I have no power to change the world. Even if the order is imperfect, if there's no way to change it, I'll protect it.」

153:t_3:49.en:
$$リディ$$
「Even $$サイデリアル$$ has come from space. If we don't stabilize the world even a little now, this planet, and you...」

153:t_3:52.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「It's $$サイデリアル$$! They're attacking $$オーブ$$!」

153:t_3:53.en:
$$マーサ$$
(They're too early... No, it's because our departure was delayed...)

153:t_3:54.en:
$$マーサ$$
(One thing is certain: they aren't giving a thought to us, even though we've pledged to cooperate...)

153:t_3:56.en:
$$リディ$$
「Hold on, $$ミネバ$$! I'm coming over now!」

153:t_3:57.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...$$リディ$$... You and I follow different paths.」

153:t_3:58.en:
$$リディ$$
「Is this the time to say that! If you fall from there, you'll die!」

153:t_3:59.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I am a woman of the $$ザビ家$$. I will see what $$ラプラスの箱$$ truly is with my own eyes.」

153:t_3:60.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I've believed even a twisted order was better than war. But if all it does is suffocate people...」

153:t_3:62.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「In this chaotic world, doing that may be meaningless.」

153:t_3:63.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「By seeking the truth, I may cause further chaos and commit a grave sin like my father and grandfather. But I...」

153:t_3:64.en:
$$リディ$$
「Do you intend to fight the world alone!?」

153:t_3:66.en:
$$リディ$$
「Nobody believes the world will change! Nobody cares about a world a hundred years from now, when they won't be around!」

153:t_3:67.en:
$$リディ$$
「What they want instead is a way to survive!」

153:t_3:68.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But without a future, people fall into despair. Humanity learned that in the $$時獄戦役$$.」

153:t_3:69.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「And I am not alone. The light in people's hearts has made me certain of that.」

154:t_000:0.en:
$$キサカ$$
「The force arranged by $$アナハイム$$ is coming!」

154:t_000:1.en:
$$カガリ$$
「It's the $$連邦軍$$ that defected to $$サイデリアル$$...!」

154:t_000:2.en:
$$キサカ$$
「Also, the $$アークエンジェル$$ is holding back the enemy's advance from the north of the island!」

154:t_000:3.en:
$$カガリ$$
「Deploy $$オノゴロ島$$'s defense force!」

154:t_001:0.en:
$$キサカ$$
「All units! The enemy's target is this residence! Do not let them get close!」

154:t_002:0.en:
$$リディ$$
(Damn you, Dad... So this is why you told me to leave $$オーブ$$ after $$ミネバ$$ was transferred...)

154:t_002:1.en:
$$リディ$$
(Damn it...! With the world in this state, just how rotten can you be...!)

154:t_002:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「Let's do this, $$キラ$$! They've broken away from the regular Federation military! That makes them enemies of Earth!」

154:t_002:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「If you're saying you won't aim for the cockpits, do as you please. I'll do what I want too.」

154:t_003:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「They were... under Dad's influence too...?」

154:t_004:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「Let's do this anyway, Ensign $$リディ$$, to protect what we cherish.」

154:t_004:2.en:
$$リディ$$
(It isn't the $$マーセナス家$$... It's...)

154:t_004:6.en:
$$マーサ$$
「There's nothing to worry about. Our pickup will be here soon.」

154:t_004:8.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$マリーダ・クルス$$. What is the meaning of this?」

154:t_004:9.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「$$マリーダ$$...? I am $$プロト・プルトゥエルブ$$.」

154:t_004:11.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「Master, please give me your orders.」
